title: Mikey Sol and Roqru - Fall So Deep
htmlContent:
Mikey Sol and Roqru's "Fall So Deep" embodies all of their musical styles that we have grown to love. An authentic feel in the rhyme style, that shows a true student of the game and master of their craft, while being entertaining and refreshing that it’s a breath of fresh air from the present status quo, that makes them a stand out talent.

The latest from Mikey Sol and Roqru, “Fall So Deep” is an exciting, memorable track that hooks the listener in from the get-go.
